name: audio-generation
description:
Use when the user wants any audio work on a video — generating a text-to-speech voiceover or narration, cloning a voice from a sample, transcribing speech to text wit
        +h word-level timing, dubbing / translating a video into another language, or laying a background-music bed. Maps each task to the right tool (generate_tts, create_voice, split_audi
        +o, transcribe_audio, music_generate), explains the ElevenLabs inline delivery tags for emotion and accent, and gives the transcribe → translate → re-voice chain for dubbing. Trigge
        +r whenever the user mentions voiceover, narration, TTS, reading a script aloud, voice cloning, dubbing, translating the audio, caption / subtitle timing, or background music — even
        + if they do not say "audio".
author: Official
